glossary.label: Provenance
glossary.definition: The recorded relationships among a resource, its inputs and how it was produced. This does not prove truth.

glossary.label: Applicability
glossary.definition: Whether evidence fits the intended use and conditions; extrapolation beyond evaluated conditions needs justification.

glossary.label: Overreliance
glossary.definition: Accepting an AI suggestion when that suggestion is wrong; the linked experiment investigates ways to reduce this.

glossary.label: Excerpt integrity
glossary.definition: Whether the stored text matches its pinned hash. A match does not prove source accuracy or present-day currency.

glossary.label: Claim support
glossary.definition: Whether a passage actually warrants a statement. Resolving a reference is not enough; this prototype does not automate that judgment.

glossary.label: Missing information
glossary.definition: An explicit gap that remains unresolved, not a reason to invent content.

ai_assistance.method: AI-assisted assembly, working glossary and interpretations from inspected public excerpts. Source authors retain attribution. No runtime model call is made by the workspace.

limitations: Three purposively selected excerpts, not a systematic literature review or clinical guidance.
Independent professional appraisal, nurse walkthroughs and learning outcomes remain pending.
All sources are read-only snapshots; no live source-refresh or semantic entailment service exists.
The project review date is a maintenance reminder, not a claim that evidence expires on that date.
